name: MeDo app builder
verification: Official capability documentation read 2026-11-09; this verifies documented capabilities, not a specific generated app.

claims.generation: Can generate a web or mobile product from a plain-language request.
claims.backend: Generated apps can include user accounts, permissions, backend logic and a connected database when requested.
claims.iteration: Apps can be refined through conversation and published to a shareable MeDo URL.

limitations: Do not promise prices, credits, third-party integrations, local model hosting or native app-store packaging.
Generated apps need functional and security testing; do not guarantee production readiness or multi-tenant isolation.
This is an app builder, not a verified replacement for Zapier/n8n workflow execution and monitoring.
